presentation.name: Project adaptation
presentation.summary: Adapts installed skills to this repository by writing where things live and what the team calls them into a rules file the agent reads.
benefits: Maps the repository so the agent finds pipelines, configs and docs without searching
Binds the project's own terms to the generic terms the skills use
Records the naming, branch and documentation conventions actually in force
Says which installed skill applies to which part of the repository
Stays local to your checkout unless you choose to share it with the team
